name: micro editor
description: Installs the micro terminal editor at build time from micro-editor/micro's own release tarball — by default the latest release, resolved at build time rather than a version this repo tracks — verified against the release's published SHA-256. micro is non-modal: typing inserts, Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+Q quits, the mouse selects, with syntax highlighting for over a hundred languages built in. Sets no EDITOR: devc web already prefers micro when EDITOR is unset, and `export EDITOR=micro` is yours to choose everywhere else.

version.description: micro release to install. 'latest' resolves the newest release from micro-editor/micro at build time — this repo does not pin or track a version. Otherwise a release version such as '2.0.15' (a leading 'v', as GitHub's tag has it, is accepted too).
